newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RBA denies it's a "wages policeman" - union official.
newsitem.headline: RBA denies it's a "wages policeman" - union official.

text.p: The president of the Transport Workers Union (TWU) said on Wednesday that Reserve Bank of Australia governor Ian Macfarlane had denied the central bank had a role as a "wages policeman" but would continue to intervene in settlements where it thought it was necessary.
Macfarlane met TWU officials earlier today after a labour court's decision last month to reject a wage rise claim from the TWU.

"He did say to us that in the past they had, where they believed it was necessary, intervened in particular industry settlements and he said to us that they believed they would continue to do so in future," said TWU president Steve Hutchins told reporters after the meeting.
"They denied that they had a role as a wages policeman," he said.
